metadata.custom_settings:
md_loading:
  enabled: true

js_loading:
  enabled: true

ts_loading:
  enabled: true

tsx_loading:
  enabled: true

functions_loading:
  enabled: true

ddl_loading:
  enabled: fasle
  files:
    - ./KB/current_DB_schema.sql
    - ./migrations/schema.sql

table_loading:
  enabled: false
  schema: kosmos
  include_patterns:
    - "%"
  exclude_patterns:
    - "pg_%"
